events.verdict: Turner (IND) initiates illegal contact with Green's (GSW) left arm as he reaches across in order to get to the ball.
Wiggins (GSW) moves alongside Nembhard's (IND) path and the body contact during the driving shot attempt is marginal.
Wiggins (GSW) maintains a collapsed forearm against Nembhard's (IND) side and Green (GSW) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Nembhard (IND) attempts to save the ball but throws it out of bounds.

Mathurin (IND) contests Curry's (GSW) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal. Mathurin closes out to the side of Curry, who extends his leg to create any further contact.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on Turner (IND) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Kuminga (GSW) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds and Indiana is given possession of the ball.
Nembhard (IND) firms up in a screening position in Kuminga's (GSW) path and two players briefly engage and disengage.
Siakam (IND) reaches in and initiates contact with Kuminga's (GSW) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Schroder (GSW) commits a take foul on Nembhard (IND).
Green (GSW) establishes himself in a screening position in McConnell's (IND) path and does not deliver contact.
McConnell (IND) legally contests Hield's (GSW) jump shot attempt.
